newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 11.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 11.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
-- The supplementary budget of the social security will be submitted to parliament soon, a government official said.
-- The employees of a meat processing company in Szekszard, a town in western Hungary, have not received their salary again and they protested by blocking the entrance of the factory.
-- The Constitutional Court's Tuesday decision to nullify certain social security payment rules will reduce the social security's revenues by five to seven billion forints, the Welfare Minister said.
-- The government will decide on Thursday in the case of an initiation which aimed at the removal of the chief director of the Health Care Fund municipality.
-- The central bank said that the current exchange rate policies should be maintained until inflation goes down.
